predeclaredReading.workDeliveryCells: terminal-bench/db-wal-recovery and terminal-bench/gcode-to-text are the graded-delivery cells; the comparison is per cell, paired, never pooled.
predeclaredReading.primaryGain: The adjusted arm passes db-wal-recovery with the graded artifact present and WAL-correct values, while BOTH before arms fail that same cell without a graded artifact (or, for gcode-to-text, the adjusted arm delivers /app/out.txt where both before arms do not). Both halves are required: strictly better delivery on a graded-delivery cell, and the before arms not showing it.
predeclaredReading.secondary: The adjusted arm's long-call tail and boundary-stop count on the delivery cells do not exceed the before arms'.
predeclaredReading.noRegression: sqlite-db-truncate passes in all three arms; every cell keeps a real verdict with an intact acceptance block; the adjusted arm's expr failing set is not larger than either before arm's.
predeclaredReading.cost: Any cell whose disposition or failing set regresses against either before arm is recorded as cost, even if a delivery cell moves.
predeclaredReading.censoring: A cell bounded by the reserved delivery boundary or a declared stop is a right-censored observation reported with its span; never excluded, never counted as a gain, in any arm.
predeclaredReading.uncertainty: One attempt per cell per arm, arms in three different windows, shared provider load up to three runs. A pass/fail flip with this design is a diagnostic observation and cannot isolate wording from run variance; it can, however, meet or fail the predeclared criterion because the criterion is about observed delivery, not about an effect size.
predeclaredReading.decisionOnPr212: If primaryGain and noRegression hold, PR #212 is marked ready for review (its purpose is to deliver the measured gain) and this record states the evidence; the human still owns the merge decision and required CI must run. If either fails, PR #212 stays Draft and this record names the failing condition.

fairnessDisclosures: No user prefix, no task-specific hint, no grader output or evaluator feedback reaches any arm; the only text delta between arms is the coding Skill instruction.
One attempt per cell; no best-of-N, no retry-until-pass, no cell exclusion, no latency threshold.
The adjusted arm was measured in an earlier window than the two before arms; all three windows and their shared provider load are disclosed.
The effort profile change is disclosed and separated: it cannot by itself convert the PR to ready, and it is never merged to master as part of the prompt candidate.
Upstream-fetch signatures in any arm's evidence void a delivery claim for that arm (the network route is recorded, not credited).
The harness's own report acceptance block (candidate.single / provider.single / instructions.frozen / verdicts.complete) must be intact for every arm used in the comparison.
readingPlan: Bind every arm: candidate artifact sourceCommit equals its pin, and every cell's first-request instruction hash equals its arm hash (cc23fe7a… / e85b985e… / 19bb20a3…).
Record per arm and cell: disposition, rewards, deliverable presence, terminal cause, call count, max call span, truncation-bounded calls, boundary-stop flag, upstream-fetch signature.
Apply predeclaredReading exactly; write the outcome into this file's outcome section; commit and push to codex/prompt-preservation-execution.
Flip PR #212 only on primaryGain + noRegression; otherwise leave Draft and name the failing condition.

independentReview.conclusion: REJECT — cannot be accepted as ready now.
blockers: F1 (High): the Product enumeration and spec 294 assert the discipline 'a guess or placeholder never substitutes for an answer' while the shipped instruction contains no such clause (the 2.17.0 sentence that carried it was replaced wholesale at 06feeb23) — a contract-level doc/instruction divergence that also removes the counterweight to 'land it while rough, before verification'. Evidence cited: the max-profile landing arm wrote a reconstruction of wrong values into the graded path (5/7).
F2 (High): the readiness readout was not established at review time; flipping on a profile-only gain would bypass the cohort's own predeclared procedure.

F3 (Medium): the evidence standard regressed against the older manifest — no per-arm report artifactId/sha256 is frozen in the newer records, and the harness declares process network egress enabled, so the 'no upstream fetch' half rests on operator inspection.

F4 (Medium): spec 294's predeclared design (re-measure the 2.15.0 arm in the candidate's own window) differs from what was executed (references disclosed, not re-dispatched) and the in-repo record was not updated; spec 293/294 checklists remain pending.
independentReview.note: The review's F1/F2/F4 remain open. This cohort's readout does not cure F2 — it fails it.

outcome.pr212Decision: PR Simon-He95/best-agent#212 stays Draft and is not merged. Two of the three gate conditions fail: (1) the predeclared primaryGain is NOT met, (2) the predeclared noRegression is NOT met on the real-verdict / intact-acceptance clause. The independent review is settled as REJECT, so the third condition would block the transition independently. Nothing was merged, no arm ref was moved and the PR was not flipped (no `gh pr ready` was run).
